select i.inquiry_id, i.inquiry_no, i.work_id, i.buyer_id, i.seller_id, i.license_type, i.intended_use, i.budget, i.message, i.status, i.expire_at, i.created_at, i.updated_at, i.create_by, i.create_time, i.remark, w.title as work_title, ub.nick_name as buyer_name, us.nick_name as seller_name from sys_inquiry i left join sys_work w on i.work_id = w.work_id left join sys_user ub on i.buyer_id = ub.user_id left join sys_user us on i.seller_id = us.user_id
AND i.inquiry_no like concat('%', #{inquiryNo}, '%') AND i.status = #{status} AND i.license_type = #{licenseType} AND w.title like concat('%', #{workTitle}, '%')
AND (i.inquiry_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or w.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by i.created_at desc

select i.*, w.title as work_title, ub.nick_name as buyer_name, us.nick_name as seller_name from sys_inquiry i left join sys_work w on i.work_id = w.work_id left join sys_user ub on i.buyer_id = ub.user_id left join sys_user us on i.seller_id = us.user_id where i.inquiry_id = #{inquiryId}
